# opengrid (build123d)

This repository is a **[build123d](https://build123d.readthedocs.io/)** implementation of **[openGrid](https://www.opengrid.world/)**, the modular wall-and-desk mounting framework and ecosystem (28 mm grid, Gridfinity-compatible, and related integrations—see the official site for the full picture).

The upstream concept, documentation, and community live at **[opengrid.world](https://www.opengrid.world/)**.

This project is open source under the **MIT License**; see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).
